yt_description:
monday.com or Stackby? We compared monday.com Standard with Stackby Economy on databases, apps, workflows, interfaces and AI, then priced both for a team of 3.

monday.com Standard: $432 a year ($12/seat/month × 3, billed annually).
Stackby Economy: $149 a year for 3 users.
That's $283 saved every year, 66% less.

Feature by feature
• Relational database: monday.com Boards + connect columns · Stackby Linked tables, typed fields
• Automations / month: monday.com 250 actions · Stackby 1,000 runs
• Live data from your apps: monday.com 250 integration actions · Stackby API columns included
• Apps & portals: monday.com Dashboards & forms · Stackby Interfaces included
• AI: monday.com AI credits · Stackby Included
• Need more?: monday.com Pro: $19/seat/mo · Stackby Business: $299/yr, 3 users
• 3 users, billed yearly: monday.com $432 / year · Stackby $149 / year · Economy

Stackby plans (3 users included, billed annually)
• Economy: $149/year for 3 users (7,000 records per database, 1,000 automation runs / month, interfaces, AI & API columns)
• Business: $299/year for 3 users (50,000 records per database, 25,000 automation runs / month, interfaces, AI, API columns & sync)
• Pro: $449/year for 3 users (100,000 records per database, 100,000 automation runs / month, custom domain & enterprise access)
Every plan includes AI, API columns and interfaces/portals. Business and Pro add sync connectors for Instagram, YouTube, Meta Ads and more; Pro adds enterprise access.

👉 Try Stackby free: https://stackby.com/signup

What you'll see built
• Sales CRM
• Work Management
• Approvals Workflow
• Company Intranet
